main.description: Tell the owners in the capacity queue who are due a notice that there's room again, at most 15 a call, at their proven contact address. Stops when the email budget is full. Staff only.

idempotencyKey.description: A UUID the client generates once per press and resends on every retry of it.

noContact.description: Due owners with no contact address; the dashboard tells them.

notVerified.description: Due owners whose contact address isn't proven to be theirs.

remaining.description: Due owners not tried this call: past the per-call limit, or the budget is full. Press again.

retryAt.description: When the email budget has room again, if it filled.

errors.name: AuthRequired
errors.description: This endpoint requires an authenticated caller.

errors.name: InvalidRequest
errors.description: idempotencyKey is missing or malformed, or the provisioner refused the request as malformed.

errors.name: Forbidden
errors.description: The caller is not HappyProto staff, or the provisioner does not know them as staff.

errors.name: Upstream
errors.description: The provisioner is unreachable, not configured, or answered with an error it does not explain to callers.
